name: restore-legacy-gameplay
description: Exact byte replacements restoring original base single-player functions while preserving every opt-in v8-v16 network movement/animation hunk. Do not apply to original snapshots.
format_note: This JSON file is ASCII. JSON old/new strings represent exact source bytes via Latin-1 code points; encode each value using latin-1 before binary comparison/replacement. Do not decode source as UTF-8 or normalize line endings.
apply_policy: Target only a development copy. Validate every whole-file input SHA before any write.
Each old byte sequence must occur exactly once. Apply replacements in listed order to an in-memory byte buffer.
Validate the complete output SHA before atomically writing that file. Never accept partial matches or patch by line number.
Build and validate standalone, co-op authority and Versus overrides. Do not force health/camera/input in a global Timer or Tick.
